You chose B. So I shut my eyes, and folded my hands. In the darkness, I heard Krishna laugh softly. Open your eyes, little one. Stay till the end, because what happened on day fourteen still gives me chills.

When I opened them, Arjuna was standing tall again, his great bow Gandiva in his hand. The war had begun. Thirteen days of arrows and dust. On the thirteenth day, Arjuna's young son Abhimanyu was trapped and killed.
Arjuna made a terrible vow. If I don't defeat Jayadratha before sunset tomorrow, I will walk into fire myself. But the next day, Jayadratha hid behind the whole Kaurava army.
Hours passed. The sun sank lower and lower. Wait, was Arjuna going to lose? Then Krishna raised His hand. His chakra flew up, and covered the sun. The whole battlefield went dark. Only I saw it.
Jayadratha stepped out, laughing, thinking the sun had set. So what should I do? Comment A, tell Arjuna the sun is still up. Or comment B, keep Krishna's secret. Part four, tomorrow.
